attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The ContentTypes AdminController change adds submit-based branching (redirect/notify) into what appears to be the GET display Edit(string id) action rather than the actual POST save handler, which could break the save-and-continue flow or show a false success notification without persisting data, though the change is scoped to two admin editor screens."}

reason: The ContentTypes AdminController change adds submit-based branching (redirect/notify) into what appears to be the GET display Edit(string id) action rather than the actual POST save handler, which could break the save-and-continue flow or show a false success notification without persisting data, though the change is scoped to two admin editor screens.
